model: released Fast-WAM Optional-IDM clean checkpoint; idm mode

transform.name: smooth05_hadamard
transform.source: reuse exact saved transforms from original successful full banks; no refitting or alpha search

weight_scope: all 614 target Linears; video306/action307/root-proprio1; no highprecision restoration branch
activation: dynamic per-row signed symmetric absmax A4 qmax7; decoded BF16
unquantized: KV cache, bias, normalization, nonlinearities, text encoder, VAE and other non-target modules

microscaling.axis: input dimension within each output row
microscaling.row_gain: reuse exact existing BF16 row RMS
microscaling.books_shared: two books shared within each Linear
microscaling.metric: same A4 input diagonal second moment multiplied by actual block scale squared

reuse.moments: recompute same BF16W+A4 calibration path once; persist sums/counts to resume
reuse.local_diagnostics: existing frozen teacher inputs/outputs in source sensitivity captures; no sensitivity recapture

evaluation.primary_metric: first10 x 6 motor RMSE versus same-input same-seed BF16; average seeds within case then average cases
evaluation.method_selection: none; B32 and all fitting settings frozen before any new query
evaluation.reuse_boundary: existing test results already seen; paired mechanism diagnostic, not a new independent generalization test

claim_scope: Numerical B32 exponent scaling with BF16 additive books; no INT4-book, native-kernel, latency or closed-loop claim
